prompt: Original Brass Sanctuary architectural craft: warm pale sandstone, restrained aged-brass inlay, believable hand-carved construction. Broad symmetrical wings wrap along each side of a tapered bracket; central oval sun medallion and deep stepped relief borders. Flat vertical back mounting plane, square load-bearing top, complete closed volume. Crisp chisel-cut planes, chipped exposed corners, dust only in recesses. No face, no human deity, no building, no pedestal beyond the corbel itself.
